name: android-tools
description: Two adb-based CLI tools for Android development: a live logcat streamer with a TUI and a UI automation driver.

requirements.device: Connected Android device or emulator with USB debugging authorized

tools.name: logstream
tools.description: Live Android log streamer - logcat, but actually nice
tools.long_description: Streams `adb logcat` (threadtime, main/system/crash buffers) filtered to one app package, with a ratatui TUI (search, level/tag filters, pid tracking, crash and restart banners) plus plain and JSONL output modes for piping.

flags.name: --package
flags.description: App package name (release, then .debug is auto-tried).

flags.name: --serial
flags.description: adb serial (auto-picked when a single device is connected).

flags.name: --tag
flags.description: Keep only tags starting with this prefix (repeatable).

flags.name: --skip
flags.description: Drop tags starting with this prefix (repeatable).

flags.name: --search
flags.description: Initial search query (also filterable live with / in the TUI).

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Write JSON lines (one object per record) instead of the TUI.

flags.name: --plain
flags.description: Plain colored output (no TUI). Auto-selected when stdout is not a TTY.

flags.name: --out
flags.description: Mirror output to this file (works with any mode).

features: App-pid filtering with crash history kept across restarts
Crash / start / restart / died banners (AndroidRuntime FATAL EXCEPTION detection)
Stack-trace continuation lines merged into the record
Live TUI with regex search, level and tag filters
JSONL and plain modes for scripts, optional file mirror

tools.name: uitool
tools.description: Practical Android UI driver — dump, find, tap, shot over adb
tools.long_description: Drives a device UI from the command line: dumps the uiautomator hierarchy as labeled lines, finds/waits for nodes by text or content-desc, taps by label or coordinates, swipes, takes cropped/scaled screenshots, launches activities, sends keys and text.

requires.screen_on: uiautomator dump fails on a locked/off screen

global_flags.name: --serial
global_flags.description: adb serial (auto-picked when a single device is connected).

subcommands.name: wake
subcommands.description: Wake + dismiss keyguard + collapse status bar.

subcommands.name: dump
subcommands.description: Dump UI hierarchy: one line per labeled node (`text [bounds]`).

subcommands.name: find
subcommands.description: Find nodes matching text/content-desc (case-insensitive substring). Exit 1 if none.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a node matches (poll dump).

subcommands.name: tap
subcommands.description: Tap by coordinates or by label.

subcommands.name: launch
subcommands.description: Launch an activity (appends /.MainActivity when only a package is given).

features: Label-based interaction: tap/find/wait use text or content-desc, no coordinates needed
Clickable nodes preferred as tap target, bounds center computed automatically
uiautomator dump with hard timeout (no hangs) and screen-off detection
Screenshot pipeline: crop, nearest upscale, max-dim resize, JPEG quality
Serial auto-pick when exactly one device is connected
